basics.name: suffix
basics.label: Resource name suffix
basics.toolTip: Short unique suffix appended to every resource name (e.g. 'helpdesk-prod'). Keep it 3–16 characters — Key Vault names are capped at 24 characters total.

constraints.validationMessage: 3–16 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. Cannot start or end with a hyphen.

options.text: S1 (Standard) is the recommended default — no special quota required and ~40% cheaper than P1v3. Use P1v3 or P2v3 for production workloads requiring deployment slots or higher compute. B2 (Basic tier) requires Basic VM quota which many Azure subscriptions do not include.

elements.name: skuName
elements.label: App Service plan SKU
elements.toolTip: Controls compute size for all three App Service apps. All apps share a single plan.

elements.name: storageRedundancy
elements.label: Storage account redundancy
elements.toolTip: Determines how session data in Azure Table Storage is replicated. ZRS survives a zone failure; GRS survives a full region outage.

elements.name: storageAccountName
elements.label: Storage account name (optional)
elements.toolTip: Leave blank to auto-generate from the suffix. If the auto-generated name is already taken, enter a unique name here. Must be 3–24 lowercase letters and digits only — no hyphens.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave blank for auto-generated name, or enter 3–24 lowercase letters and digits only (no hyphens).

elements.name: keyVaultName
elements.label: Key Vault name (optional)
elements.toolTip: Leave blank to auto-generate `kv-<suffix>`. If that name is already taken, enter a unique Key Vault name here. Must be 3–24 lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, start with a letter, and end with a letter or number.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave blank for auto-generated name, or enter a valid Key Vault name (3–24 lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens).

elements.name: corporateIpRange
elements.label: Corporate IP range (CIDR) — Agent Portal access restriction
elements.toolTip: CIDR block allowed to reach the Agent Portal. Use your organisation's egress IP range to prevent public access. Leave as 0.0.0.0/0 to allow all IPs (not recommended for production).

options.text: Run scripts/New-AppRegistration.ps1 before deploying — it creates the app registration and certificate and prints the client ID to copy below. Click the link to open your app registrations in a new tab.

elements.name: tenantId
elements.label: Entra tenant ID (Directory ID)
elements.toolTip: Your Microsoft Entra Directory (tenant) ID — auto-filled from the selected subscription. Only change this if you are deploying to a different tenant.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a valid GUID (format: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx).

elements.name: clientId
elements.label: App registration client ID (Application ID)
elements.toolTip: Application (client) ID printed by New-AppRegistration.ps1. You can leave this blank and update the app setting after deployment. To find it manually: open Entra admin center → App registrations → your app → Overview → copy 'Application (client) ID'.
elements.placeholder: Leave blank to fill in after deployment

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a valid GUID or left blank.

options.text: Open App registrations in Entra admin center →

elements.name: helpDeskGroupId
elements.label: Helpdesk agents group object ID
elements.toolTip: Object ID of the Entra security group whose members are helpdesk agents. You can leave this blank and update the app setting after deployment. To find it: open Entra admin center → Groups → your group → Overview → copy 'Object ID'.
elements.placeholder: Leave blank to fill in after deployment

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a valid GUID or left blank.

options.text: Open Groups in Entra admin center →

elements.name: certName
elements.label: Certificate name in Key Vault
elements.toolTip: Name of the certificate created by New-AppRegistration.ps1. Change this only if you used a custom -CertName when running the script.

subLabel.preValidation: Configure your Entra Verified ID tenant

options.text: These values come from your Entra Verified ID tenant configuration in the Entra admin center under Verified ID → Organization settings.

elements.name: credentialType
elements.label: Credential type
elements.toolTip: Verifiable credential type name as configured in your Entra Verified ID tenant (e.g. 'EmployeeVerifiedCredential').

elements.name: didAuthority
elements.label: DID authority
elements.toolTip: Decentralized identifier (DID) for your Verified ID tenant. Found in Entra admin center → Verified ID → Organization settings → Tenant DID.

options.text: The app uses Microsoft Graph to send email and Teams notifications on behalf of this user. The user must have a valid Exchange Online mailbox. The app registration needs Mail.Send and Chat.ReadWrite.All permissions.

elements.name: senderEmail
elements.label: Sender email address (UPN)
elements.toolTip: User Principal Name (email address) of the mailbox account used to send verification notifications.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a valid email address.

elements.name: senderUserId
elements.label: Sender user object ID
elements.toolTip: Entra object ID of the sender user account. Found in Entra admin center → Users → the user → Overview.
